# Meaning Global

> > Meaning Global is a visionary strategy consultancy led by Dr. Martina Olbert, pioneering humanistic capitalism and brand meaning for the future of business.

Founded by Dr. Martina Olbert, Meaning Global helps brands and businesses navigate cultural shifts by embedding human meaning into strategy. The firm's work spans brand strategy, luxury evolution, and conscious capitalism, with insights featured in Forbes, Vogue Business, BBC, and WARC.
